title: Plant and Metagenomic DNA Extraction of Mucilaginous Seeds
author: Ramos, Salazar, et al.
materials: Eventually, a co-extraction of RNA and PCR inhibitors can occurs [7]. In order to avoid future problems with the genomic analysis, perform the purification steps using the DNeasy Plant Minikit (Qiagen).

steps.title: Prepare fermented seed material
steps.instruction: Harvest fresh cupuassu (Theobroma grandiflorum) seeds, place them in 24 L polystyrene fermentation boxes that have 2 cm diameter holes at the bottom and sides, mix in chopped banana leaves as a natural inoculum, cover the mass with banana leaves, ferment for 68–116 h, then collect approximately 12 g of fermented seeds in triplicate.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL pre‑heated extraction buffer (2 % CTAB, 2 % polyvinylpyrrolidone, 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 25 mM EDTA, 2.0 M NaCl, 10 mg RNase, 10 % β‑mercaptoethanol) to the frozen seed samples, vortex, then incubate in a dry bath at 65 °C for 30 min, vortexing every 5 min.

steps.title: Add saturated NaCl and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Allow the samples to reach room temperature, add 300 µL saturated NaCl, mix, and centrifuge at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add 5 M NaCl to supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL tube, add 160 µL 5 M NaCl, and homogenize.

steps.title: First chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol extraction
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the tube, mix by vortex or inversion, then centrifuge at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: CTAB treatment and second CIA extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper (superior) phase to another 2 mL tube, add 50 µL 10 % CTAB solution containing 1.4 M NaCl, vortex, add 600 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), homogenize by inversion, and centrifuge at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Repeat CIA extraction
steps.instruction: Take the superior phase from the previous step and perform another chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) extraction as in the first CIA step (add CIA, mix, centrifuge).

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting aqueous phase to a 1.5 mL tube, add cold isopropanol to fill the tube, mix, and incubate at –20 °C for 12 h for DNA precipitation.

steps.title: Centrifuge and ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min, discard supernatant, wash the pellet twice with 400 µL 70 % ethanol (30 min each) and once with absolute ethanol for 3 min.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet in a dry bath at 70 °C for 5 min, then resuspend in 40 µL DNase‑free water.

steps.title: Purify DNA with DNeasy kit
steps.instruction: Perform the DNeasy Plant Minikit (Qiagen) purification according to the manufacturer’s instructions to remove co‑extracted RNA and PCR inhibitors.
